time_scale_model: Resolved civil birth labels before 1972 are UT1: TT = UT1 + the pinned delta-T model. This convention approximates historical civil UTC; fractional 1961-1971 UTC adjustments are not reconstructed. From 1972, UTC→TAI uses hifitime 4.3.1 IERS leap seconds; TAI−UTC is 37 s from 2017 (27 inserted leaps plus initial 10 s). TT = TAI + 32.184 s. TT→TDB adds the periodic relativistic term, bounded by about 1.7 ms. Raw proleptic UTC Epoch APIs use TAI−UTC = 0 before 1972 and do not interpret historical civil clocks. Future UTC follows the pinned table, not live observations. SPK interpolation uses physical TDB; chart Earth rotation retains explicit UT1.
